name: CSO_USER_INTERACTION
description: This table records the User Interactions with Knowledge.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: User Id for which the interaction is recorded.

columns.name: APP_SESSION_ID
columns.description: This field captures application session id for external apps.

columns.name: USER_TYPE
columns.description: User Type for this interaction's user.

columns.name: INTERACTION_STATUS
columns.description: Status flag for this interaction. values S - Success and F - Failure.

columns.name: INTERACTION_REFERENCE
columns.description: Content Identifier or Search Identifier for this interaction.

columns.name: INTERACTION_NORMAL_TEXT
columns.description: Normalized search term for this search.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
